name: UltraTech Cement Ltd
title: UltraTech Cement Ltd - 532538 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: UltraTech's Q4 FY26 call shows pricing and cost-efficiency gains with 200 Mt capacity, but supply is still expanding (242.5 Mt by FY28) and management pushes shareholder returns over capacity discipline; West Asia cost headwinds are being offset by price hikes.

utilisation.quote: we have operated at 90% capacity utilization across our network

capex.quote: We see a plan of investing around INR8,000 crores to INR10,000 crores every year for the foreseeable future.

triggers.label: Grey cement pricing up ~2.5%
triggers.quote: grey cement pricing strengthened about 2.5% in most geographies

triggers.label: Utilisation ~90% across network
triggers.quote: we have operated at 90% capacity utilization across our network

triggers.label: Capacity to 242.5 Mt by FY28
triggers.quote: which will take us over 242.5 million tons in a phased manner by fiscal '28

triggers.label: Efficiency programme >INR300/t
triggers.quote: we will deliver higher than INR300 by fiscal '28

guidance.quote: We expect a sustainable volume growth of 7% to 8% per annum.
1.54x is our target to reach by fiscal '28.
this definitely is going to take us over INR1,000 per ton, as committed by the end of fiscal '28.
